questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'My purchases' with 'To Pay' selected and a 'Pending payment' order card says what this is.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The order card is tappable via its chevron but nothing on it says 'Pay', so the next action isn't the most noticeable thing.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: The tabs are clear, but the order card's only cue is a '›' on 'Pending payment', which doesn't say it opens payment.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'To Pay', 'In progress', 'Completed' and 'Pending payment' are plain.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decision is asked beyond opening the order.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The card shows only seller, thumbnail, '1 item' and total.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Buyer's purchases list and seller's empty 'My sales' both fit post-order.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels carry it; the seller's empty state is one line.
